pages.pageTitle: Senator Kim Hammer for Secretary of State
pages.rawText: Senator Kim Hammer for Secretary of State #1 in the Nation for Election Integrity. As Secretary of State, he says he will implement election laws and keep Arkansas secure for voting. Paid for by Hammer for Secretary of State.
headings: #1 in the Nation for Election Integrity
claims: Arkansas is #1 in the nation for election integrity.
Campaign states SOS implementation will follow legislature and executive orders.
repeatedPhrases: #1 in the Nation for Election Integrity
policyPromises: Implement election laws passed by the legislature.
Maintain Arkansas as secure voting jurisdiction.
electionOrSosClaims: Voters can trust Arkansas remains secure place to vote.

pages.rawText: Biography page states Senate election in 2018 after House service, committee assignments, legislative accomplishments, public ministry and hospice background, and Benton/Saline area context.
claims: Served in House for eight years and elected to Senate in 2018.
Lists committee assignments and legislative activity.
electionOrSosClaims: Election and SOS-related legislation highlighted as qualifications.

pages.rawText: Issue page describes campaign election-integrity framing, lists acts and policy outcomes, and positions against outside influence. Includes SOS campaign promises tied to election-security enforcement and county coordination.
claims: Campaign claims election legislation made Arkansas most secure in nation.
policyPromises: Coordinate with State Board and counties.
electionOrSosClaims: As Secretary of State, continue strengthening election laws.

pages.rawText: Issues landing page is sparse and primarily routes to election security, news, volunteer, and donation pages.
repeatedPhrases: Paid for by Hammer for Secretary of State

pages.rawText: News index page links to election-integrity statement and campaign launch announcement.
policyPromises: Election process confidence and security commitments.
electionOrSosClaims: Secretary of State campaign messaging tied to election administration.

pages.rawText: Volunteer intake form requesting contact and location data; includes disclaimer and campaign attribution.
repeatedPhrases: Paid for by Hammer for Secretary of State

pages.rawText: Privacy policy covers data collection, cookies, disclosures, and child privacy. States data is not sold.
claims: Campaign states data will not be sold.

pages.rawText: Terms page covers recurring campaign SMS and donation message consent and opt-out language.
Campaign announcement describes SOS candidacy, election-reform leadership, county clerk/election commissioner coordination, and business/commercial licensing priorities.
headings: State Senator Kim Hammer Announces Campaign for Arkansas Secretary of State
claims: Campaign says legislative election reform helped Arkansas become top state for integrity/security.
Campaign references business endorsements and bureaucracy reduction goals.
policyPromises: Work with legislative and administrative branches.
Reduce bureaucracy and red tape for business.
electionOrSosClaims: Will coordinate with county clerks and election commissioners.
Will preserve capitol grounds integrity and safety.

pages.rawText: Long-form argument for election integrity reforms, historical framing, and SOS platform positioning around transparent, secure election administration.
headings: Arkansas Leads the Way in Election Integrity: A Commitment to Fairness and Transparency
claims: Election integrity is central to constitutional legitimacy.
Campaign cites Heritage ranking and act package as evidence of state security.
Campaign identifies modern threats and need for continued refinement.
policyPromises: Work with legislature, governor, state board, and counties.
electionOrSosClaims: Ensuring legal votes count and only legal votes counted.

pages.rawText: Statement cites Heritage election scorecard ranking and links campaign platform to election administration priorities.
headings: Secretary of State Candidate Senator Kim Hammer Releases Statement on Arkansas’ Rank as #1 in the Nation for Election Integrity
claims: Campaign says legislation made Arkansas #1 for election safety/security.
repeatedPhrases: state's rank at the very top
policyPromises: Work with legislature, state board, and counties to keep ranking.
electionOrSosClaims: As SOS, keep election-security standards and rankings high.
